acceptance_criteria.criterion: detectVariables() uses FormatParser internally and returns array of matched format-string tokens
hasUnnumberedPlaceholders('Hello %s') returns true; hasUnnumberedPlaceholders('Hello %1$s') returns false
All FormatParser calls are wrapped in try/catch returning safe defaults on exception
composer analyze passes with no new PHPStan errors

summary: Replaced preg_match_all hand-rolled regex in detectVariables() with FormatParser-based implementation returning getFormatString() tokens.
Added getPlaceholderNumbers(string $text): int[] using FormatParser, returns sorted unique numbered argument indices, with try/catch returning [] on ParserException.
Added hasUnnumberedPlaceholders(string $text): bool using FormatParser, returns true if any placeholder has isNumbered()===false, with try/catch returning false on exception.
Added use Mistralys\SprintfParser\FormatParser and use Mistralys\SprintfParser\FormatParser\ParserException imports.
composer analyze (PHPStan level 8): no errors. composer test: 95/95 pass.
